title: Neural Texture Compression Reproducibility Across GPU Vendors
root_cause: Neural Texture Compression uses ML inference for decompression. FP16 numerical differences between NVIDIA Tensor Cores, AMD Matrix Cores, and Intel XMX produce bit-exact differences in decompressed output. Cross-platform multiplayer games see texture hash mismatches.
resolution_type: Deterministic inference profile. Fixed-point quantization specified for inference. Reference CPU decoder for authoritative cross-platform verification.
